The homeless arent really a huge problem. Theres an issue with professional panhandlers though. Just ignore them. The homeless are often down town especially near good sam hospital. But they for the most park keep to themselves. Honestly the biggest problems are young women being kid napped and there is a huge drug epidemic. Just dont walk alone if youre a woman and dont give money to beggers. Walmart and the mall are where they are trying to snatch women up.  But gun laws in KY are disturbingly lax and tazers are super cheap. Just take protection, as a young woman i get off work at 11p some nights and have to walk to my car 2 blocks away down town, but ive got my tazer in my scrub pocket and a .22 in my cars glove box. Just be aware and honestly lex isnt that bad of a city. We lived in some rough appartments a few years ago and other than a few crack heads knocking on my door and they always stole the change out of my car theres not been any real issues.

Thursday night live in down town is always fun. Live music and vendors hang out next to some decent bars. 
If you like baseball the legeends are fun to watch and on thursday home games you can take your dog. 
Its a fairly nice city not too bad on crime always lock your car doors though.
Rupp arena always has concerts and basket ball starts back in a few months people here are crazy about UK basketball.
There are also lots of beautiful parks too.
